overview: The Masi (Caro-Masi) plays 2...Nf6 against 2.d4, intending ...d5. White can play 3.e5 Ne4 (Nd5) and gain space, or 3.Nc3 d5 4.e5 Ne4, reaching Caro-Kann positions with the knight on e4. Black gets a solid structure but White has more space.

white_ideas.idea: Gain space with e5 and play Bd3, f4 or Nf3
Challenge the e4 knight with Nxe4 and Qa4 ideas
Develop a kingside attack from a space edge

black_ideas.idea: Play ...d5 and strike at the e5 pawn with ...c5 or ...f6
Trade the advanced knight and equalise

typical_structures.structure: Caro-Kann/Alekhine-like structure with a White pawn on e5 and Black pawn on c6, d5

character.notes: Solid Black structure against White space; play is manoeuvring.

structure.notes: White e5 advance gives a locked-ish centre.

approach.notes: Rarely used but a respectable Caro-Kann move order.

level.notes: Plans are simple but White space needs care.

character.reason: Caro-Kann shell, hard to break down.

structure.reason: The advance structure with e5 locks the centre in the main lines.

approach.reason: Rare but a respectable move order.

level.reason: Simple ideas, needs understanding of the advance structures.
